entry.name: pin
entry.label: Whether to keep the popup open when it loses focus

entry.name: icon
entry.label: The name of the icon used in the compact representation (e.g. on a small panel).

entry.name: menuLabel
entry.label: Text label for the Panel button

entry.name: appNameFormat
entry.label: The format used in the display of application names: 0 = NameOnly, 1 = GenericNameOnly, 2 = NameAndGenericName, 3 = GenericNameAndName

entry.name: centerOnScreen
entry.label: Whether to center the widget on the screen

entry.name: primaryActions
entry.label: Which actions should be displayed in the footer: 0 = Power, 1 = Session, 2 = Custom, 3 = Power and session

entry.name: showActionButtonCaptions
entry.label: Whether to display captions ("shut down", "log out", etc.) for the footer action buttons

entry.name: compactMode
entry.label: Whether to use a compact display style for list items
